profile.summary: Senior Microsoft Dynamics AX  Developer with more than 9 years' expertise. Experience in retail, warehouse managment, projects, supply chain, finance, dif, AR, AP. Experience working with Microsoft Gold Partner, and have worked on several full cycle implementations.
